delta.comment: Lineage-path correction (narrow Stage follow-up, 2026-08-24): references entry `.backlogit/queue/027-DL.md` -> `.backlogit/archive/027-DL.md`, matching 027-DL's archived location. TOOLING GAP: backlogit 1.10.1 exposes `references` only at create time (`backlogit add --references`); neither `backlogit update` nor `backlogit_update_item` has a references parameter, and `link add/remove` operates on the ID-keyed semantic-links table, not the path-valued `references` frontmatter field, so it cannot repair a stale path. Applied the repository-approved narrow workaround instead: direct edit of the single frontmatter line in the markdown source of truth (Data Ownership Rule -- markdown is current-state truth; only generated cache artifacts are off-limits), followed by index rehydration per the Index Freshness Rule. Verified via sync_index + query_sql. No other field, no body text, and no lifecycle state changed; 147-F remains `status: queued`.
PR #406 local review propagated the unconditional shipment-record requirement and pre-close qualifying-feature status capture into the parent contract.
